testimonials.text: I found the detailed explanation of the different types of vascular malformations, capillary, venous, lymphatic, arteriovenous, and mixed, particularly interesting. The discussion of their clinical presentations, associated complications, and the Schobinger staging system for AVMs was especially valuable. I also appreciated the practical surgical cases, including preoperative evaluation, debulking techniques, and postoperative management. These real examples made the content clear, applicable, and clinically relevant.
I found all the aspects of the course very interesting.
Very informative indication of surgical treatment of VM.
Clear and systematically mapped out overview.
